snippet.title: Bloom - a puzzle adventure - PC Trailer
snippet.description:
Bloom - a puzzle adventure - is coming to Steam!
Experience the game in its full beauty in landscape, designed from the ground up. Play and make community levels across platforms. Try the Demo on Steam today!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3300090/Bloom__a_puzzle_adventure/
